The cluster comprises 11,000 NVIDIA H100 and about 1,448 A100 GPUs, based on documents submitted to Develop Fulton as [reported by Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/xai-elon-musk-x-new-atlanta-data-center-2025-2). xAI occupies part of this multi-tenant building, so its cooling is not attributed to xAI alone.
